# Adopted common form without BaseForm

These complete event blocks are extracted from native 8.3.27.2214 imports of
ServiceDesk's adopted `CommonForm.СвязанныеДокументы`, body
`52bddabb-6ba5-4616-9a71-5392d506cf86.0`. Fresh disposable BSP clones were used
for each successful oracle. Native export retains the corresponding callType.

The laboratory trees explicitly increment Configuration Version from
`1.7.0.0` to `1.7.0.1`, preserving its four-component format. No BSL or data
metadata changed. These files are event-block evidence, not a delivered CFE;
no CFE was built for these measurements.

Before stores code 0 on the first handler. After stores an empty first
handler and an additional handler with code 1. Override stores code 2 on the
first handler. The compiler and reader tests use these blocks verbatim.

Full provenance, raw row hashes, native command results and measured limits:
[`docs/extensions/evidence/form-interceptors-20261001.md`](../../../../docs/extensions/evidence/form-interceptors-20261001.md).
